Social media and the internet have an endless supply of inspiration and step-by-step instructions for improving your home. We’re here to help make sure your work follows all building and electrical codes, as required by law. These codes are in place to ensure that your project is done properly.

Every year, we help homeowners, contractors and commercial builders safely complete thousands of projects across Boone County. Whether your project is big or small, the permitting process follows the same basic steps:

- Phase 2: Edit auto-opens/creates revision via existing startEstimateRevision/ensureOpenEstimateRevision (handleEditProtected), all guards kept (CAS, price-acceptance, pipeline_sync_pending); cancelled stays locked (decision, flippable); trash open to all statuses, WO-delete guard deep-links to job; EstimatorQueues quick actions dup/archive/trash + FIXED pre-existing missing useRef import crash; ZERO InventoryMovement on estimate paths confirmed. PASS estimate-relax + lifecycle/save-recovery/persistence regression.
- #363 ensureIdempotentEntityCreate concurrent-dup guard (RESIDUAL: backend unique constraint on creation_request_key still needed)

- Drive-per-job folders: googleDriveOperations.ensureJobFolder — reuses saved WorkOrder.google_drive_folder_url, else resolves configured roots (GlobalSettings driveConfig/googleDriveConfig) or app-owned CCS Jobs root, creates WO-number+client folder, CAS-safe write only-if-empty.
